title: CPF Module Schema: Purview Account
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-purviewaccount'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

identity.description: (Optional) An identity block as defined below object({ type = "(Required) Specifies the type of Managed Service Identity that should be configured on this Purview Account. Possible values are `SystemAssigned`, `UserAssigned`, `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned` (to enable both)." identity_ids = "(Optional) Specifies a list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs to be assigned to this Purview Account. This is required when `type` is set to `UserAssigned` or `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned`." })

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

managedEventHubState.description: (Optional) Gets or sets the state of managed eventhub. If enabled managed eventhub will be created, if disabled the managed eventhub will be removed.

managedResourceGroupName.description: (Optional) Gets or sets the managed resource group name.

parent_id.description: (Required) The ID of the azure resource in which this resource is created. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

publicNetworkAccess.description: (Optional) Gets or sets the public network access.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

id.description: The ID of the Purview Account.

name.description: The Name of the Purview Account.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Purviewaccount' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
